_doc: Plain code/data patches applied by insert.py. 'patch': bytes written over the source ROM (orig asserted). 'vanilla': [start, end) ranges copied back from clean FireRed. Offsets are ROM offsets.

naming_vanilla.why: Use FireRed's own name-entry screen instead of the hack's Chinese one (pinyin page, misplaced entry line). The hack hooked DoNamingScreen/CB2_LoadNamingScreen to its screen at 0x9FF5EB4/0x9FF505C, swapped the first key handler, the text-entry box template and the controls text, and redrew the buttons in Chinese. Restored here. Kept from the hack: its extended template table (literal at NamingScreen_Init 0x9DB58 -> 0x9DE4EC4: number/phrase/password/category inputs, initialPage=upper), the u16 player-avatar gfx id (0x9EF68), translated titles. Its intro calls its own screen directly (bl at 0x9FF4214, out of BL range of vanilla), so its entry becomes an ARM trampoline to vanilla DoNamingScreen; r0-r3 and stack args untouched. DoNamingScreen (vanilla entry 0x9D954 and the hack's entry 0x9FF5EB4) now jumps to a dispatcher built by insert.py: templates 0-4 (player/box/nickname/rival) run FireRed's screen; the hack's own templates 5-9 (number/phrase/password/category) crash FireRed's screen, so they go to the hack's screen as before (its old hook stored r0 at [sp]).

vanilla_battle_text.why: Live vanilla battle strings the hack half-overwrote in place (broken 2-byte codes such as 07 FE, leftover English like '…with its opponent!', 的/是/果 suffixes the dump skips as single characters). Restored to FireRed's English; each range was checked to be untouched by our build.

naming_abc_default.why: Hack's own name-entry screen (still used for its number/phrase/password/category prompts): open on the ABC page instead of the pinyin page. Init (0x9FF505C) zeroes currentPage (struct+0x2622, sNamingScreen at 0x203998C); the keyboard draw (0x9FF5A00) loads page 0's tilemap and preloads page 1's. Select still cycles CHN -> symbols -> ABC.

patch.asm: r2=base+0x261A; strh 0,1,0 at +0x261A/C/E... (same stores as before) then 0x2620=0, page(0x2622)=2; ldr r1,=0x262C kept
patch._note: orig: ldr r2 / strh r3,[r0,r2] pairs for 0x261A..0x2622 (ldr r2,=0x261A at 0x1FF50A0 kept)
